tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Find upcoming Contact Improvisation events worldwide: festivals, workshops, intensives, retreats, long jams and residencies. Use for questions like 'CI festivals in Germany this summer' or 'workshops with <teacher>'. Filter by country, city, dates, type, practice or free text. Returns up to 20 event

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get the full listing of one event: dates and times, venue and address, description, prices, teachers, organizers, level and languages. Use after search_events, or when the user gives a citreasurehunt.com event link. Accepts the event id (e.g. 'W27r') or the URL.

tools.name: search_teachers
tools.description: Find Contact Improvisation teachers, organizers and musicians by name, or by where they are based. Use for 'who teaches CI in <city>' or to look up a person mentioned in an event. Returns short profiles with slug and URL; call get_teacher for the full bio and their upcoming events.

tools.name: get_teacher
tools.description: Get one person's public profile: bio, where they are based, practices, years of experience and their upcoming events. Use with a slug from search_teachers or from a get_event teacher link.

tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Find dance studios and retreat centers that host Contact Improvisation classes, jams and events, by name, country or city. Use for 'where is CI taught in <city>' alongside search_communities. Returns venues with slug and URL; call get_venue for the address and upcoming events.

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: Get one venue's public details: address, description, website and the upcoming events it hosts. Use with a slug from search_venues or from a get_event venue link.

tools.name: search_communities
tools.description: Find local Contact Improvisation communities, the groups that run regular weekly jams and classes, by country, city or name. The primary tool for 'where can I dance CI in <city>' or 'is there a CI jam in <city>'. Returns communities with slug and URL; call get_community for details.

tools.name: get_community
tools.description: Get one local community's public details: what it runs, where, in which languages, the people and venues involved, and events it organizes. Use with a slug from search_communities. Group chat invite links and contacts are only on the community's page, not returned here.
